input.prompt: The planner predicts every Slice as the median one, so a one-line fix and a 200-file removal get the same figures. Can you size each Slice by the files it will touch when planning?

required: choices validates a list and refuses a broken one
a list with no items yet, such as a new task's decisions.md, is valid (P98)
the agreement shows the plan's size last (P101), and its Technical part the plan from estimate --plan --json (P87)
a sized plan: the Size line gives the range, the most likely cost and what it rests on, and each Slice its own figures (P18)
choices renders the agreement, the hand-over filter and the catch-up from the record
with a Schema 5 record, the list is decisions.md beside it and the catch-up reads the current Slice's update lines
a Slice's prediction: the median of the first pool with three measured Slices, corrected by the geometric mean of actual over predicted, pulled toward none (P16)
slice start records the prediction beside the first reading, and slice close keeps it beside the actual
estimate --plan lays the Slices left across compaction cycles, with the totals, the oversized and the parallel
estimate --plan before three Slices are measured anywhere: this compaction cycle's rate, from --done
Slices measured with --used carry context only: the prediction and the plan give no time or cost for them
estimate --project and --store add up what was measured, and size a task with nothing measured from others' data
a sized Slice: its files times the median per-file rate, corrected only by sized predictions, and a zero reading is not measured (P13 to P18)
slice start writes Size and Base, slice close writes Files from Base to HEAD, and slice size adds Files to an older Slice
